name: Singbonga
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Singbonga brings separate woodland constituencies together around shared political claims and public recognition. Agreements over grazing and access give the movement concrete obligations while member communities retain their own leadership. The University register proposes a connection to Narmada Archives Rival Grove Concession Copies. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
